description: This file provides Chinese (Taiwan) localization for the Select2 plugin, version 4.0.6-rc.1. It defines translation strings for various user interface messages used by the plugin.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns a message indicating how many characters to delete when input is too long.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns a message indicating how many more characters to input when input is too short.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that more items are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns a message indicating the maximum number of items that can be selected.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that no matching results were found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that a search is in progress.
